# Kip

> Kip runs your organic social media. You text a photo to Kip; it writes the caption in your brand voice; you reply "yes"; it posts to Instagram, Facebook, X and Threads. Nothing posts without your approval unless you turn on Autopilot.

Kip is a product of Pulse Social Media. It is built for small shops, creators and founders who want to stay consistent on social media without hiring a social media manager or wrestling with a scheduling dashboard. The whole workflow lives in an SMS text thread.

## What Kip does

- Writes captions in your voice from a photo you text in.
- Publishes organic posts to Instagram, Facebook, X and Threads (organic only — no paid ads or media buying).
- Waits for your "yes" before every post by default; optional Autopilot posts for you after a heads-up.
- Runs a weekly Monday check-in, a Friday recap, and a quiet reminder if you haven't sent a photo in 10 days.
- Keeps an editable brand memory so the voice stays consistent.
- Encrypts data in transit and at rest; never sells data or uses it to train models.

## What Kip does not do

- No paid advertising or media buying.
- No on-site photo shoots or video production.
- No strategy decks or stand-up meetings.

## Pricing

- Plans start at USD $79/month, up to around $149/month for higher tiers.
- Positioned between a typical scheduling tool ($15–$100+/month, but you still write the posts) and hiring a social media manager ($2,000–$5,000/month).
- Cancel anytime on monthly plans. First-week refund if it isn't useful.

## Getting started

- Setup takes about ten minutes: connect your channels, text a photo, approve the first caption.
- Most people are live the same day.
